newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial buys Ohio, Minn. properties.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial buys Ohio, Minn. properties.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Monday it acquired for $3.7 million a 102,500 square foot light industrial property in Solon, Ohio, giving the real estate company a presence in the Cleveland area.
Built in 1991, the single-tenant building is fully leased. The facility is located on a 10.4 acre site that can accommodate future expansion of up to 68,000 square feet.
First Industrial opened its Cleveland regional office in September.

Separately, First Industrial said it acquired five properties in the Minneapolis area representing 368,736 square feet for a total investment of $13.9 million. The company also said it completed a 172,800 square foot build-to-suit project at an expected cost of $7.2 million.
The six total properties increase First Industrial's Minneapolis portfolio to more than 4.6 million square feet.
First Industrial owns, manages, acquires and develops bulk warehouse and light industrial properties in 15 major markets in the central United States.
